generator.scope: uniform field, resistive circuit, Faraday derivative, signed motion, energy balance; not manufacturing geometry

stirling.scope: exact finite connecting rods, uniform pressure, ideal gas, isothermal spaces, ideal regenerator, midpoint flywheel and brake dynamics; no real engine performance or swept collision guarantee

governor.scope: equal-arm Porter geometry, coupled shaft/arm dynamics, simplified motor and proportional position feedback; no hardware or manufacturing calibration

eddy.scope: low-speed phenomenological eddy damping, exact disk sector inertia and field-patch overlap, analytic energy decay; slot factor illustrative, no field solution or hardware calibration
